name: Axiom Network One
creator: HelixCorp Media Division
description: The dominant corporate news and entertainment network of GLMZ, Axiom Network One delivers round-the-clock neural-feed content ranging from sanitized political coverage to lifestyle programming for Tiers 3 through 5. Its signature aesthetic — warm amber palettes, authoritative mid-register voice synthesis, and relentless optimism about corponation governance — has made it both the most-watched and most-distrusted broadcast entity in the city. Every major HelixCorp policy announcement reaches the public first through ANO's flagship evening feed, 'The Meridian Compact Hour.'
medium: neural feed (primary), holographic display (public), legacy video (Tier 2 overflow)
cultural_impact: ANO sets the conversational agenda for middle and upper-middle Meridian; its framing of the Gray Zone unrest, augmentation policy, and corponation mergers shapes what Tier 3-4 citizens believe is politically possible.
controversy: Leaked internal editorial memos in 2218 — distributed via pirate feed — revealed that ANO's coverage of the Sable Charter labor riots was suppressed for eleven days at HelixCorp's direct instruction, triggering a brief but intense credibility crisis.
story_hooks: A mid-level ANO journalist stumbles onto a story that editorial has been ordered to kill — and must decide whether the risk of leaking it is worth their contract, their chrome, and possibly their freedom.
A the Gray Zone community is falsely portrayed in an ANO segment as the origin of a disease outbreak; the community has 72 hours before the story calcifies into public consensus.
Someone is feeding ANO's editorial team pre-fabricated news packages of suspiciously high production quality — and no one can identify the source.
